item.title: Waymo Aims for 2028 Singapore Robotaxi Launch with Ojai
item.description: Waymo will ship its Ojai robotaxi fleet to Singapore in 2027 for mapping and testing, aiming for a robotaxi service by 2028 after LTA approval.
